name: Demo - Average
description: Compute the average of a selected column in a federated way.

functions.name: read_csv
functions.description: Extract data from a CSV database to yield a dataframe.

functions.name: read_excel
functions.description: Extract data from an Excel database to yield a dataframe.

arguments.name: sheet_name
arguments.description: Name of the sheet to read from the Excel file. If None, the first sheet is read.

functions.name: read_parquet
functions.description: Extract data from a Parquet database to yield a dataframe.

functions.name: read_sparql_database
functions.description: Extract data from a SPARQL database to yield a dataframe.

functions.name: read_sql_database
functions.description: Extract data from a SQL database to yield a dataframe.

functions.name: central_average
functions.description: Compute the global average of a column across all participating organizations.

arguments.name: column_name
arguments.description: Column for which to compute the global average

databases.name: Database
databases.description: Database to use for the average computation

functions.name: partial_average
functions.description: Compute local sum and row count for a single organization.

arguments.name: column_name
arguments.description: Column for which to compute the local sum and count

databases.name: Database
databases.description: Database to use for the partial average computation
